steps.what: Set the visual intent and constraints for complex graphics and animation
Explore still-image treatments for the proposed graphics and animation style

loop.purpose: Generate candidate still-image treatments for artist-led exploration
loop.input: candidate image brief and authorised style references
loop.output: candidate visual treatments with generation provenance
loop.check: Artist checks composition, brief fit, visual identity, undesirable likenesses, and feasibility for later animation
loop.stop: One candidate set and one correction; unusable candidates return to manual sketching
loop.why_not_simpler: Creative visual exploration cannot be reduced to filling fixed layout fields

steps.what: Choose and refine the complex design for production feasibility and expressive effect

tasks.design: In the visual-authoring application {OTHER}, assist only still-image exploration from an artist-defined brief. The artist chooses and refines the design; no claim is made that a generated still provides a usable animated scene.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exploring alternative visual treatments takes drawing and editing effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Image generation can provide candidate treatments for critical comparison.
tasks.still_hard: Original direction, shot continuity, coherent motion, and production feasibility.
tasks.human_edge: The artist decides which design serves the intended emotional and narrative effect.
tasks.altitude: A little less candidate sketching; creative decisions and production responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain why a treatment serves the creative brief

evidence.claim: Adobe Creative Studio generates and edits images with Content Credentials; this supports still-image candidates, not coherent finished animation.
The small time estimate for artist-reviewed candidates is an E1 scenario without local production measurements.

assumptions: Boundary covers complex visual design and look exploration; specific motion modelling and animation execution belong to the separate image-in-motion task. OTHER is the visual-authoring application.

Artist produces intended subject, composition, audience, style constraints, prohibited content, reference permissions, and technical limits in s1; brief capture remains counted. Missing permissions or unusable candidates require manual design.
Test native brushes, reusable assets, and variation tools before a model loop. Generated candidates stay internal and do not imply rights clearance or final approval.
unknowns: Permitted generation tools and source rights
Project need for original visual identity
research_questions: Do candidate generation and cleanup reduce effort while preserving design originality and production feasibility?

already_counted.description: Choose and refine the production design

incremental.description: Maintain candidate constraints and provenance checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=92.5; gross 7.5 minus 4 upkeep gives net 3.5. Range assumes some usable image candidates; continuity-intensive or distinctive designs may save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create basic commercial designs and illustrations

steps.what: Choose the concept and requirements for labels, cartons, mail, or television illustrations
Draw the basic designs and illustrations for the chosen concept

loop.purpose: Create editable candidate illustrations from the artist's concept
loop.input: illustration brief and permitted selected references
loop.check: Artist checks subject accuracy, composition, brand fit, unwanted similarity, and suitability at the intended size
loop.stop: One candidate set and one revision; unacceptable output is drawn manually
loop.why_not_simpler: An original illustration needs visual synthesis beyond a fixed template

steps.what: Refine and check the illustration before handing over the design proof

tasks.design: Use the image-authoring application {OTHER} for candidate illustration generation after the artist selects the concept. The artist refines the proof and checks it against the brief before normal art-direction and production approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Initial illustration takes substantial execution work even after the concept is chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: Editable generated candidates can shorten some basic illustration work.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate lettering, distinctive design, rights, and precise reproduction requirements.
tasks.human_edge: The artist judges communication quality and corrects visual errors that look superficially plausible.
tasks.altitude: More effort can go to proof quality; concept and final selection remain human.

reach.task: Prepare a design proof for downstream reproduction checks
reach.learn: Format limits and proof handover requirements

evidence.claim: Adobe Creative Studio generates and edits images with Content Credentials, supporting candidate illustration creation.
The proposed effort reduction is E1 and does not inherit vendor campaign cost claims.

assumptions: Boundary covers basic commercial illustration and proof handover, excluding final campaign release and complex animation look development. OTHER is the image-authoring application.

Artist captures subject, concept, intended placement, dimensions, colour constraints, required text, brand assets and permitted references in s1; capture time remains. Exact text and brand marks are inserted or corrected manually rather than trusted to generated pixels.
Test native templates and reusable assets first. Missing rights or unsuitable candidates return to manual illustration; normal downstream approval remains unchanged.
research_questions: How often do generated candidates require redrawing before the design proof is usable?

already_counted.description: Refine and check the proof for normal approval

incremental.description: Check provenance and maintain generation constraints

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=86; gross 14 minus 6 upkeep gives net 8. Range assumes simple illustrative subjects; exact typography or tightly controlled packaging can yield no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Agree campaign budgets, schedules, dependencies, and production responsibilities
Create campaign background designs within the agreed production direction
Collect production progress and resolve budget or scheduling conflicts with contributors
Compile the campaign progress tracker from verified status and budget records

tasks.design: Configure a progress view in {PROJECT} from the artist's verified status records. Budget choices, scheduling negotiation, contributor clarification, and background design remain human; the view compiles what is known rather than predicting completion.
tasks.previous_blocker: A progress tracker can repeat information already collected during coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project views can calculate agreed budget and schedule comparisons from explicit fields.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving competing creative priorities and unreliable estimates.
tasks.human_edge: The artist negotiates workable trade-offs and knows when a status needs clarification.
tasks.altitude: Less tracker compilation; coordination and budget decisions remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain a verified schedule or budget variance

evidence.claim: A native project view can compile verified production status without deciding priorities or creative completion; this is an E1 design estimate.

assumptions: Boundary is artist campaign coordination and distinct campaign background work. Do not add the same background-production hours again under the general graphics task; team roll-up assigns each action once. OTHER is the visual-authoring application.

Artist records task identifier, responsible contributor, planned date, reported date, confirmed status, planned cost, actual cost and source timestamp in s1 and s3; capture and clarification remain counted. Contributors supply existing updates after work occurs, before s3 verification, with unchanged effort.
No inferred completion flag is used. Missing or disputed fields stay unknown in the view and require manual clarification. Test native project views before custom integration.
research_questions: Does native compilation reduce active tracking effort after status capture and contributor clarification are included?

already_counted.description: Collect, verify, and resolve production status

incremental.description: Maintain status fields and check progress-view mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross 20 minus 6 upkeep gives net 14. Range assumes repeated tracker compilation for multi-contributor campaigns; existing native views may save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create animated two- and three-dimensional images

steps.what: Model the objects and scene required to illustrate motion or a process
Animate the objects and adjust timing, motion, and visual relationships
Check the animated images for continuity, clarity, and process accuracy

tasks.design: Retain modelling, motion work, and perceptual checking in the animation application {OTHER}. Existing interpolation and rendering are already part of the tool and earn no new labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: A plausible frame does not establish coherent motion or an accurate process explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest does not establish an improvement for finished controllable animation in this scope.
tasks.still_hard: Timing, continuity, scene relationships, and the meaning communicated through motion.
tasks.human_edge: The artist sees when an animation is technically valid but misleading or hard to follow.

reach.task: Explain a scene constraint affecting animation delivery

evidence.claim: The digest's image-generation capability does not establish controllable two- or three-dimensional motion production; no time reduction is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is execution of motion imagery from existing visual direction, excluding look-development work counted in the complex-design task. OTHER is the animation and modelling application.

Artist creates geometry and scene relationships in s1 and motion in s2; all capture and editing time remains counted. Process references and approved direction come from existing project owners before s1.

Test native animation tools before proposing custom code. Unchanged modelling, interpolation, rendering and review add zero incremental upkeep; unattended render runtime is excluded from human shares.
research_questions: Which active animation operations are repeated and could be changed without degrading controllability?

incremental.description: No additional system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net saving zero. Existing tool runtime is not new labour saving and active motion production remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The artist can test bounded image candidates and compile verified campaign status while retaining visual direction and motion judgement.
role.ambitious_version: An artist who explores useful visual alternatives and gives producers reliable progress information without surrendering creative control.
